subject: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA/BAA/SOC2)

Subject: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA/BAA/SOC2)

Hi Susan / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned on deployment/controls: 

Summary of needs you mentioned:
- Must support HIPAA workloads; Elara requires a signed BAA and SOC 2 Type II evidence.
- Audit needs: access to audit logs for model inference, retention of logs for 6 years, and exportable traces for security review.
- Data residency: must ensure patient data never leaves the US region.
- Peak throughput estimate: ~200 concurrent inference sessions; typical latency SLO 200-300ms.

Deployment options we discussed (short):
1) Hosted API + BAA: fastest onboarding, Redwood signs a BAA and we can provide SOC 2 Type II report and dedicated logging/export hooks. Good for most customers but has multi-tenant control plane (we isolate customer data at rest and in transit).
2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool): Provides isolated inference capacity and stronger isolation for customers who want predictable throughput and additional contract controls. Still uses Redwood control plane but with dedicated compute.
3) Private (VPC/on-prem): Full customer-managed networking, private control plane option — recommended where regulatory or audit teams require exclusive network isolation and on-prem deployments.

What I’ll do: attach our latest SOC 2 Type II report and a draft BAA for your legal team to review. Tomorrow I’ll loop in Dylan (solutions) and Rishi (security) to map your audit questions to our controls and to propose a MAP with timelines.

Requested from Elara: could you confirm who from your security/infra team we should include for the technical review and any existing questionnaire (eg., a vendor security questionnaire or the specific audit items you need us to address)?

Next steps / proposed timeline:
- 3/31: Technical deep-dive with Solutions + Elara infra (30-60m)
- 4/4: Legal/Procurement review of BAA & T&Cs
- 4/11: Pilot plan for Dedicated capacity (if needed) or Hosted+BAA trial

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf, Redwood_BAA_Draft_Elara.docx

Thanks -- happy to be flexible on sequencing.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Susan / team —

Appreciate the questions -- quick answers below ahead of today’s technical call. We’ll run the demo and then go into the MAP and artifacts.

1) Hosted API + BAA
- Control plane: multi-tenant control plane for management/telemetry, but inference data is processed in isolated compute namespaces and encrypted at rest. We can enable a US-only processing constraint on your account (we run region pins and region affinity policies).
- Audit logs: we provide tenant-scoped audit logs and API-level request/response metadata. Export formats: JSON/CSV. We can push exports to a customer-owned S3 via cross-account role or provide a signed export bundle.

2) Dedicated capacity
- Adds dedicated GPU pools and dedicated compute namespaces for your account. Stronger isolation for noisy-neighbor concerns and predictable throughput.
- Includes customer-dedicated logging endpoints (syslog/HTTPS) and longer retention SLAs (configurable). We can also enable additional logging detail for audit runs.

3) Private (VPC/on-prem)
- Full network isolation. Control plane can be either customer-managed or a private control plane hosted in your VPC. Best for customers that require on-prem or air-gapped controls.

PII/redaction: we offer configurable redaction at export time (PII tokenization and redaction rules). For SOC/audit exports we can produce a sanitized export and a separate secured export that contains full metadata under stronger contractual terms.

Attached: a short MAP (high level) and the SOC 2 report and draft BAA Marissa shared. Proposed next steps:
- 3/31 10:30 PT: Technical call (demo + logging deep dive)
- 4/4: Legal review of BAA (Elara & Redwood)
- 4/11: Start pilot (Hosted+BAA) or Dedicated trial, depending on infra feedback

If you want, after the call we can provide a specific scoping doc that maps Elara’s questionnaire fields to our SOC2 controls.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
